onset.Description: Time of the stimulus onset in seconds relative to the beginning of the experiment t=0.

duration.Description: Duration of the stimulus presentation in seconds.

trial_type.Description: The condition of the stimulus being presented from the DOTSloc task (physics/social)

identifier.Description: The name of the movie file that is presented on a given trial.

correct_response.LongName: Match between Participant response & Expected Response
correct_response.Description: Participant responses are collected after the missing dot reappears to indicate if the dot appeared where they expected it to. This is matched with the expected response.
